text_block_list.text:
Starting today, the summer training camp 
for improving skills begins.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, looks like we didn't leave 
anything behind. Thank you very much, 
driver.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... The air is as fresh as ever out 
here!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, besides training, it'd 
be nice if we could all go swimming in the 
sea."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's consult Hishi Ama first.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's do our best at this 
year's summer training camp too! Trainer.

And so, the intense summer training camp 
with Fuji Kiseki began!
